wikimediacustomizations-desc: The WikimediaCustomization extension hosts Wikimedia-specific hooks, messages and other site customizations.
wikimediacustomizations-bademaildomain-e: Email addresses using $1 are not supported. Please choose another email provider.
wikimediacustomizations-donor-identify-l: Would you like us to remember that you donated on your Wikipedia account? Toggling this off will remove this recognition and is irreversible.
wikimediacustomizations-donor-identify-h: By linking an account, you agree to the Wikimedia Foundation offering you donor-related experiences by privately recognizing you as a supporter on {{SITENAME}}'s website and apps while you are signed in. [https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Legal:Donor%20experiences Learn more].
wikimediacustomizations-donordelightbadg: A little thank you badge for your donation!
Your generosity helps keep Wikipedia free and open for people across the globe.
This heart is a thank you badge for your donation. The badge cannot be restored after it is removed.
wc-donor-account-creation-dialog-title: Would you like us to remember that you donated on your Wikipedia account?
wc-donor-account-creation-dialog-subtitl: Thank you for your recent donation to Wikipedia!
wc-donor-account-creation-dialog-body: By linking an account, you agree to the Wikimedia Foundation offering you donor-related experiences by privately recognizing you as a supporter on Wikipedia’s website and apps while you are signed in.
wc-donor-account-creation-dialog-benefit: By linking an account, you can:
Receive updates about the impact of your support
Unlock features across Wikipedia’s website and apps
wc-donor-account-creation-success-messag: Your account will now remember that you have donated. You can unlink at any time in [[Special:Preferences#mw-prefsection-personal-email|settings]].
